summary: Carter Bankshares, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce that a lawsuit brought by the Justice Parties in West Virginia state court was voluntarily dismissed with prejudice. The filing is a routine litigation update with no special-situation transaction, strategic action, or corporate event. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other covered category. The company acted only as the filer of the report. There are no deal terms, financial details, or structural mechanics disclosed. This update is informational only, and no further action or risk-arb angle is applicable.
